title: How To Get a Felony While in a Towel
description:
On August 21st, 2023, officers responded to a case of domestic violence. Upon arriving at the scene, they tried talking to the woman in question who was wearing a towel but soon, she began escalating the whole situation. The woman began acting very aggressively with the officers. She continued to tell the officers that she was going to call the lawyers. She was showing no signs of stopping her erratic behavior. The woman was charged with resisting arrest and battery upon a peace officer.
